The new guard can therefore remove an existing parent even when displaced persistence is never considered.

recommended_design.acceptance_boundary: Change only terminal-cycle feature eligibility. Keep direct-component membership, exact measurement ownership, source measurement, persistence rules, topology scoring, thresholds, gates, references, and closed evidence unchanged.
recommended_design.candidate_rule: A cycle feature without a direct-component owner may corroborate same-scale cycle geometry only when it independently passes the existing exact-or-mutually-unique displaced persistence rule. It can never add a catalogue member. The resulting parent must still contain at least three immutable direct components and pass whole-group conflict reconciliation. No new group-wide support rule is introduced; the existing retained-support condition remains part of displaced-child matching only.
